name: Signed Bouquets Are Conditional-Antimatroid Graph Classes
hypotheses: Finite nonempty ample families; coordinate flips identify graph presentations.
statement: The signed intersection-closure and conditional-antimatroid predicates define the same existing graph class.
proof: Normalize an intersection-closed orientation at its minimum. Ampleness is equivalent to local one-element extendability. The conditional-antimatroid axioms are exactly these bouquet axioms; conversely their isometric graph presents the signed meet condition.
